verdicts.reason: Both break the product lockup. The cream circle has come loose from the bottle and sits in the bottom-left corner, cut off by the canvas edge and colliding with the can, which now reads as a ghostly orange outline. The headline is small for this canvas and 'Out now.' is tiny, leaving large dead orange areas. A also leaves a big gap between the product and the headline, so they read as separate fragments. B keeps the headline closer to the product, so it groups slightly better, but its circle is cropped more heavily and overlaps the smaller can just as badly.
